selection.qualification_scope: Screens selected after initial exploratory frontier, then checked on new repeats. No universal accuracy, force/friction consistency, temporal/mesh convergence or optimality certification. Original strict droop screen preceded the frontier.
selection.scheduling_caveat: No-contact I1/G1 executes L1-G1-L2; contact I1/G1 executes G1-L1. Selected I1 Y and DR cases have collision context; actual source ordering and any collective corrections remain part of measured cost.
negative_controls: Pulley I1 loses all contacts and drops about 0.924m despite passing the source finite-state screen.
High-stiffness droop fails strict planar shape/residual screen across tested iteration and timestep refinements; raw force defects remain large.
selection.slinky_correction: Original test reopens freeze window after impact. Independent audit exactly reproduces original values, then latches first separation<=0.3m or ground contact, same for G0/G1. I3 fails2/7 new full-step repeats; I4 passes3/3 initial-event checks. Late-contact differences remain unresolved. G0 reaches the ground by its first released sample, so it does not provide a usable free-flight freeze interval.
